additional_research.balanced_ev: Test 30/60/120-minute loss cooldown in parallel independent variants.
additional_research.capital: No scaling before adequate liquidity/slippage validation and stable prospective net portfolio returns.
additional_research.diy_whale: Test NEUTRAL-only versus strict RISK_OFF organic-flow criteria in prospectively isolated variants.
additional_research.profit_capture: Test stage exits and narrower trailing rules against the frozen baseline using executable exit estimates.
additional_research.runner_hunter: Test independently timed 2- and 3-confirmation continuation with future executable quotes.

experiments_are: historical diagnostics, not proven strategy changes

exit_capture.caveat: Observed price extrema are sampled; peak capture is price-based, before execution cost.
